baseline_note: The original compiler inventory used this revision. Compiler recognition and runtime evidence are separate. Engine evidence in audit.json is a historical snapshot pending review after active phase writes finish.
review_limit: All selected names and exact Oracle paragraphs are inventoried. Known keyword facts and limited test scopes were corrected. This is not a complete per-ability rules, runtime, or reporting review. Generic profiles and nonempty evidence paths do not establish semantic completeness.
review_unit: Oracle paragraphs include keyword lists and modal bullets. All 609 paragraphs are inventoried; paragraph coverage is not semantic review or a count of distinct Magic abilities.
new_control_validation: Test links establish only their named assertions. Run the focused tests on the integrated tree after active phase writes finish; earlier snapshot runs do not certify current engine behavior.

tested_behavior.scope: Lowered tap yield produces exactly two colorless mana. That mana cannot pay a green pip. This does not test activation timing or source use.
Lowered native tap yield produces exactly one green mana, not white or flexible mana. This does not test summoning sickness or granted mana choices.
A cast pays one black mana, produces three black mana, and puts the spell in the graveyard. Green mana alone cannot cast it.
Its own entry draws exactly one physical card while its body stays on the battlefield. A renamed source has the same result.

New controls check paid Elf draws, creature and enchantment cast filters, ordered life/draw rewards, and exact physical copies from a fixed draw spell. Direct cast-trigger dispatch does not prove every full cast or report path.

priority_gaps.required_regression: Run the same payment/filter states through complete normal and alternative casts; test only other Elves receiving the lord bonus.
priority_gaps.historical_engine_observation: Current settlement checks event filters and resolution_payment. The new narrow control covers Elf/Human and zero/one green cases. The other-Elf lord still needs typed recipients and normal cast/report integration needs separate checks.

priority_gaps.required_regression: Deal different damage amounts and assert that many green 1/1 Elf Warrior tokens. Require Lathril plus ten other eligible untapped Elves for the activation.
priority_gaps.historical_engine_observation: Current Scale has colors-present and charge counters, while generic Tokens has only a fixed count. Shared Elf tap costs have no distinct-object set in SimActivationCost. Unsupported wording must remain gated rather than execute a guessed reward.

priority_gaps.required_regression: Enter one creature with multiple creatures already present. Put one +1/+1 counter on each creature and none on the enchantment.
priority_gaps.historical_engine_observation: The current effect parser accepts source charge counters and rejects other ordinary counter placements. The effect model still lacks this +1/+1 counter distribution to every own creature; inert output is not support.

priority_gaps.required_regression: Test creature and noncreature casts separately. Test equipped and unequipped deaths, equipment leaving play, and zero-toughness state checks.
priority_gaps.historical_engine_observation: The current cast dispatcher checks creature filters and a new Beast Whisperer control tests a noncreature near miss. Skullclamp still needs equipment-host-specific death and zero-toughness behavior; a generic Dies event is insufficient.

priority_gaps.required_regression: Giada mana pays for an Angel but not a non-Angel creature. Entry counters count Angels already controlled, not all creatures or the entering Angel.
priority_gaps.historical_engine_observation: Current SpendRestriction has no Angel subtype class. Entry-counter recipients and the count of existing Angels also have no matching ordinary +1/+1 counter replacement path.

priority_gaps.required_regression: Test matching and nonmatching token/counter events, stacked replacements, and replacement source removal.
priority_gaps.historical_engine_observation: Current generic token creation and ordinary counter effects have no ordered replacement-effect pipeline for these clauses.

priority_gaps.required_regression: Use exact legal and illegal land types, nonbasic typed lands, empty libraries, separate hand and battlefield destinations, and physical-copy conservation.
priority_gaps.historical_engine_observation: game_effects.rs::search_matches omits SearchSpec.land_types. search_library selects only one result and has no shuffle. place_search_result uses the search destination's tapped flag rather than all of the found land's printed entry replacements.

priority_gaps.required_regression: Use multiple engines against one shared opponent mana budget. Check source entry time, spell type, tax size, first-spell limits, and Remora upkeep.
priority_gaps.historical_engine_observation: Current opponents.rs supplies a shared seat ledger and tax events, and beginning_phase pays supported cumulative upkeep. These are declared synthetic inputs. Complete tax interactions, first/second-event histories, source entry times, and reporting still need per-source state tests.

priority_gaps.required_regression: Use matching and nonmatching graveyard targets. Preserve physical copies, life based on mana value, and Victimize's sacrifice plus two-target dependency.
priority_gaps.historical_engine_observation: ReturnFromGraveyard stores only count and to_hand, and apply_effect_at pops cards without target filters. The life parser still uses a one-life fallback when a printed variable life amount cannot be read.

priority_gaps.required_regression: Assert three legal land plays with Azusa, additive permissions from independent sources, and restored limits after removal.
priority_gaps.historical_engine_observation: parse_static_flags stores extra_land_drops as a boolean; game_run.rs::play_land_drops uses any matching source, so neither Azusa's printed two extra plays nor stacking sources is represented.

priority_gaps.required_regression: Cast Lotus and assert tapped entry, zero immediate mana, then five fixed colors after a legal later untap.
priority_gaps.historical_engine_observation: oracle_lower/card.rs::lower_land_fields assigns enters_tapped only when land is true. Timeless Lotus is an artifact with the exact instruction Timeless Lotus enters tapped.

priority_gaps.qualification: This is a recipient-loss risk when a lord emits flags.buff, not a claim that every listed lord currently lowers or executes that buff.
priority_gaps.required_regression: Compare source, another Elf, and a non-Elf attacker; only the printed recipient set receives the bonus, and it ends when the lord leaves.
priority_gaps.historical_engine_observation: game_combat.rs::combat_phase sums every flags.buff into one team power bonus without retaining other-creature or Elf recipient filters.

priority_gaps.oracle_text: Whenever you cast an Elf spell, you may pay {G}. If you do, draw a card.
priority_gaps.required_regression: Cast a one-green Elf with one spare green and this listener present. Assert a two-mana pool reduction and two mana in the reported spending count, with exactly one trigger draw.
priority_gaps.historical_engine_observation: cast_pass/settlement.rs::fire_cast_triggers commits resolution_payment against the pool but returns no mana-spent count. cast_pass.rs records spent_total from cast resolution, while cast_resolve.rs calls fire_cast_triggers without passing spent_total.

semantic_review_unfinished_categories: Complete target and recipient legality, including resolution-time revalidation.
All alternative, additional, shared-object, and linked resolution costs.
Replacement ordering, entry modifications, and dependent drawbacks.
Granted and copied keyword abilities, attachment rules, and continuous type changes.
Event batches, per-player turn history, and delayed instructions.
Normal, alternative, replay, and permission-based cast integration.
Per-ability measurements, report classification, and advice.

parser_coverage.scope: Parser-only land-type filters include matching types and exclude nonmatching types. This is not an execution, destination, shuffle, or multi-card search claim.

compiler_coverage.note: Review compiler recognition separately; it does not establish execution.

Recursion and entry settlement are being changed. Recheck target filters and physical identities after the worker finishes.
